verdict.rationale: Remote-access products could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, such as session summaries or device analytics, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of any AI or insight-generation feature. The REST API and Python module export session data and system stats. Those are data-access building blocks, not in-product AI insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
